title: Project：Web 与 C++ 服务契约 Milestone 2

project.title: Web 与 C++ 服务契约
project.portfolioOutcome: 一个包含 React/TypeScript 消费端、运行时解码、版本化 C++ 服务边界、兼容发布说明与故障复盘的全栈项目。

objectives: 交付由 React/TypeScript 消费、经真实回环 HTTP 访问 SQLite 记录、并带版本化 envelope 与兼容性回归的本地全栈切片。
victoryConditions: CMake 构建真实 C++ HTTP/SQLite 服务；CTest 运行 producer/consumer 契约、从干净 Workspace 执行 Vite TSX 生产构建并挂载 React 组件；公开/私有请求与 Portfolio 证据全部通过。

starterFiles.CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(web_service_contract LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
find_package(SQLite3 REQUIRED)
add_executable(web-service-contract main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(web-service-contract PRIVATE Threads::Threads SQLite::SQLite3)
enable_testing()
add_executable(web_contract_tests tests.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(web_contract_tests PRIVATE PORTFOLIO_PATH=\"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/PORTFOLIO.md\" CLIENT_PATH=\"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/client.ts\" APP_PATH=\"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/App.tsx\" MAIN_PATH=\"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp\")
add_test(NAME integration-structure COMMAND web_contract_tests)
if(NOT CPP_LEARN_NODE)
find_program(CPP_LEARN_NODE node REQUIRED)
endif()
add_test(NAME consumer-contract COMMAND ${CPP_LEARN_NODE} --experimental-strip-types ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/contract.test.ts)
if(NOT CPP_LEARN_WEB_FRONTEND)
message(FATAL_ERROR "trusted Web frontend harness is required")
endif()
add_test(NAME react-build-and-mount COMMAND ${CPP_LEARN_NODE} ${CPP_LEARN_WEB_FRONTEND} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
install(TARGETS web-service-contract RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)

hints.content: 补全 SQLite step 分支并更新 Portfolio；保留 package.json 的固定 React/Vite/tsx 版本、tsconfig 的 react-jsx 配置、main.tsx createRoot 入口，以及 component.test.tsx 对 App 初始 idle 状态的服务端挂载断言。最终 CTest 必须同时通过 C++ integration、TypeScript decoder、Vite production build 与 React component mount。
